ops.body: User explicitly proposed SQLite Nov13. Confirmed existing cc-interact/store SQLite helper in cache.go, avoiding dependencies. Active implementation in live-card-sqlite-nov13 from main5c18c35: keyed thread/reference rows, explicit changed keys, no whole-map hashing/serialization, remove JSON runtime writer. Existing JSON must transfer atomically once without resurrection or fallback backend. One bounded implementer; root independent review; hosted tests then official signed unquarantined cask installation and natural IO verification. Other held tasks remain unchanged.
